title: Law to study language barriers in gifted program access
summary: This bill requires the Mayor's Office of Child Care and Early Childhood Education, working with the Department of Education and community groups, to study how language access needs and geographic location affect preschool-age children's access to early elementary gifted and talented programs. The study would examine barriers for families with limited English proficiency, the availability of translation and outreach support, and disparities in eligibility, nomination and enrollment by language group and neighborhood. A public report with findings and recommendations would be due within six months of the law taking effect.
